g.text: Every picture in the docs, every flow on the site and every card an agent draws, from data by one renderer.
Read through records. A typo, an unknown
kind or a link to nothing is refused
tickets. Each proves every word fits.
The site's palette and its light twin,
30 of Tabler's outline icons, copied in
JSON's SVG beside it. A test holds them.
An agent's ShowCard call read into a
ticket and drawn inline, its styles kept
